items.description: A self-replicating software nanobot. Forth interpreter + S-expression mesh protocol + genetic programming + distributed computation + persistence, all in one binary. Units spawn copies, evolve their own code, distribute goals across peers, hibernate and resurrect. Works across machines over UDP. Try the live demo.
A digital evolution soup built as an archaeology site: self-replicating machine code, and the instruments to work out what it became.
A soup of self-replicating machine code: one hand-written 55-instruction ancestor, and the compression, parasites and collapses that evolved from it.
